quest.title: Wagon Letter
quest.description: A mysterious letter found inside a wagon.

node.journal_entry: "My beloved one, I'm leaving you this message in the first place we met. I still remember the way the Mercian guards approached you. I thought they would kill you! I need to tell you something but I fear for anyone else learning about it. Search for my next letter at the first place you took me to watch the sunrise. The lighthouse where i could see the Fire Elementals from a safe distance while the sea surrounded us."
